body: @fedeshimo Not with the current tools, the A330 is way too old. But we could try a few things which work on DSC cameras from that era. Maybe the DSLRs have similar software. Would you be able to run a Python script to test a few things?
i know nothing about phyton but i can help you with the testing if you want

Ok, here is what you can try (supposing you work on Windows):

* Download and install [Python](https://www.python.org/downloads/).
* Download [Zadig](https://zadig.akeo.ie/)
* Download and unzip [a330.zip](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/files/7874849/a330.zip)
* Connect your camera and turn it on
* Open Zadig, check "Options -> List all devices", select your camera, select "libusb-win32", click "Install". This will replace the USB driver for your camera so that Python can access it.
* Open a console window and change to the path where you extracted a330.zip: `cd C:\path\to\a330`
* Run `python -m pip install pyusb`
* Run `python a330.py` and post the full output.

Again, it is unlikely that this will work, but we might as well try.

To get back the original USB drivers, open device manager and uninstall the device under "libusb-win32".
